New York Life is an insurance company seeking an Associate Full Stack Developer to join its Artificial Intelligence and Data group. The role focuses on designing, developing, and supporting cloud-based integration solutions, APIs, microservices, and data exchanges across the insurance domain.
Finance
Property & Casualty Insurance
Financial Services
Insurance
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Develop integration solutions using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, Spring Boot, Java, and Python
Design and build reusable integration components, services, and APIs that adhere to organizational standards and best practices
Develop and maintain integration flows, APIs, and connectors to enable reliable and efficient data exchange between systems
Integrate with various data sources, including databases, web services, messaging systems, and third-party applications
Develop and maintain microservices using Spring Boot, ensuring seamless integration with enterprise platforms and services
Collaborate with developers and cross-functional technical teams to deliver solutions aligned with architectural guidelines
Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and integration testing to ensure solution quality and performance

Required
The ideal candidate will have 1+ years of hands-on experience developing, testing, and operationalizing API and web service–based integration solutions using Agile methodologies
Experience as an Integration Developer or in a similar role, with at least 1 year of hands-on experience using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, Java, and related integration technologies
Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs
Hands-on experience with Java programming
Working knowledge of database technologies such as Oracle, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, and AWS RDS
Working knowledge of GenAI technologies and LLM API (e.g. OpenAI, Claude)
Understanding of messaging technologies such as Kafka and Amazon MQ
Experience using source control and project management tools such as Git and JIRA
Ability to develop APIs, write unit test cases, and perform unit testing
Understanding of existing and emerging API standards and secure coding practices
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
Preferred
Ability to learn new and emerging technologies and apply them to business solutions
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Detail-oriented with strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities
Self-directed, collaborative team player with effective time management skills
